title: More ways to work with text and images
summary:
Five text models joined the list, including image-capable GPT-5 Nano and reasoning model DeepSeek R1 0528.

GPT-5 Nano and Claude 3.5 Haiku joined the text model list with tool support. GPT-5 Nano also accepts image input.

OpenAI o3, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, and the reasoning model DeepSeek R1 0528 were added to the text model list.

The same PR added upstream model identifiers for nova-fast and roblox-rp, plus cached-input pricing for nova-fast. Model lists, like gardens, need labeling.
